title: Q-02 style grammar wired into the arrangement path, and what it actually did (Wave Q)
before: OrchestrateInput.styleGrammar arrived from callers, every caller left it empty, and the groove pass silently did nothing on every run. PR-48's own honest limit said so.
change: The orchestrator derives the grammar from the song being arranged: deriveStyleFingerprint -> deriveStyleGrammar -> styleGrammarSlot. The song's own behaviour is the best available description of its style.
An explicit slot from the caller still wins, including an explicit not_available, so the derivation can be suppressed rather than fought.

StyleGrammarSlot rules now carry a machine-readable `directive` beside the description. The groove pass was reading the swing ratio back out of English prose with a regex — a contract asking to be misread.
The groove pass reads directives and skips any rule that has none, rather than guessing.

contextStageDetail.pop-full: voicing plan solved (HARMONY_PLAN_V1_VOICE_LEADING:exact); style grammar STYLE_GRAMMAR_V1:full with 10 rule(s)
contextStageDetail.jazz-full: voicing plan solved (HARMONY_PLAN_V1_VOICE_LEADING:exact); style grammar STYLE_GRAMMAR_V1:full with 11 rule(s)
contextStageDetail.orchestral-midi: voicing plan solved (HARMONY_PLAN_V1_VOICE_LEADING:exact); style grammar STYLE_GRAMMAR_V1:full with 10 rule(s)

provenThePathIsLive.meaning: A real grammar with real rules now reaches every part on the context-aware path. Before this it was an empty slot on every run.

whatItChangedInTheOutput.summary: CONTEXT_AWARE_ARRANGER is not measurably better — do not promote

whyTheGrooveChangedNothing.finding: The synthesised corpus is perfectly quantised. Its measured swingRatio is 0.5 and its microtimingMs is 0.
whyTheGrooveChangedNothing.consequence: Q-02 drops both as too close to neutral to become instructions — by design, because emitting a weak swing rule from a 0.5 ratio makes every song slightly swung. The 10-11 surviving rules are register, density, harmonic rhythm and the like, which the groove pass does not act on.
whyTheGrooveChangedNothing.isThisABug: No. A perfectly quantised song has no groove to imitate, and the correct behaviour is to leave it alone. The unit test 'swing moves the off-beat and leaves the downbeat where it was' proves the pass fires when a real swing directive is present.
whyTheGrooveChangedNothing.implication: The groove half of Q-02 cannot be measured on this corpus at all. It needs recorded human performance — Q-00's real corpus — where microtiming and swing are not zero by construction.

verdict.reason: Unchanged. The context-aware path is safe and now fully wired, but still not measurably better on the synthesised corpus.

honestLimits: This makes the grammar reach the composer; it does not make the arrangement better. The A/B numbers are identical to the run before the change.
The groove pass is unexercised by this corpus. Its correctness rests on a unit test, not on a benchmark run.
Still no human has judged a blind pair.
